patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces Ninja VPN's premium mode state to PREMIUM at every server/cache write site. only some servers work (defaults to US if it doesn't).

patches.name: Change App Icon
patches.description: Custom PNG icons + labels for the spoofed Calculator / Notes / Weather slots. Real Proton logos are never touched.

options.description: PNG applied to all three spoofed slots (Calculator, Notes, Weather). A per-slot icon below overrides this. Real Proton logos are never touched.
"app" = Proton VPN, "slot" = keep each slot's own name, any other text = custom name. A per-slot label below overrides this.
PNG for the Calculator slot only. Blank = use "All three" icon.
Blank = use "All three" label. Otherwise "app", "slot", or a custom name.
PNG for the Notes slot only. Blank = use "All three" icon.
Blank = use "All three" label. Otherwise "app", "slot", or a custom name.
PNG for the Weather slot only. Blank = use "All three" icon.
Blank = use "All three" label. Otherwise "app", "slot", or a custom name.
Skip the adaptive retarget and use plain legacy bitmaps instead. Enable this if a custom icon shows up blank after patching.
Force the in-app name to "Proton VPN" (rewrites app_name and the application label), regardless of the launcher labels.

patches.name: Disable Telemetry
patches.description: Forces the observability feature flag off and short-circuits telemetry enqueue, upload, and the payments observability worker.

patches.name: Hide Upgrade Promotions
patches.description: Kills the upgrade dialog, plan congrats screen, and promo offer activity on launch.

patches.name: Lustx Unlocks
patches.description: Unlocks premium features on free plans. Each feature can be toggled individually.

options.description: Unlocks LAN connections on free plans.
Unlocks NetShield ad and tracker blocking on free plans.
Unlocks custom DNS on free plans.
Unlocks split tunneling on free plans.
Unlocks the default connection, recent connections and excluded locations on free plans.
Unlocks profiles on free plans and limits them to free locations.

patches.name: Remove Server Change Delay
patches.description: Removes the cooldown timer when switching between free servers.

patches.name: Show Free Server Locations
patches.description: Shows free server locations in the Countries list and Search, and connects to them on free plans. Paid servers stay hidden and locked.

patches.description: Removes the Postparty logo bumper from all exports. NOTE: I SUCK AT CODING, USE *MODIFIED* CLIPS. TRIM A SECOND OR ADD A STICKER!

patches.name: Enable media sniffer
patches.description: Restores Pawxy's hidden media sniffer to the toolbar.

patches.name: Rate-us popup
patches.description: Removes or rewrites the rate-us popup text.

options.description: Prevents the rate-us dialog from ever appearing. Off = rewrite mode (change text instead of removing).
Replaces rate_app_title and rate_head. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_request and rate_app_propose. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_rate_now. Only used if remove is off.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses PortDroid's signature check so the re-signed app passes validation.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks PortDroid Pro features (forces the pro gate and billing status).

patches.description: Forces SD Maid SE FOSS upgrade state to Pro.

patches.description: Unlocks all MEGA Pro features and removes ads. i'm actually not entirely sure it works - think it's jst cosmetic lol.
